links.comparator_used: Calibrating the AI threshold on a purposefully non-representative (mismatched) calibration population instead of one representative of the target clinical population
links.outcome: Distortion in cancer detection rate (CDR) when the calibration population does not match the target population
links.effect: Mismatched acquisition year: CDR distortion -3% to +19%; mismatched age: -0.2% to +27%; mismatched breast density distribution: +1% to 16%; mismatched mammography vendor: -32% to +33%
links.quote: Mismatches between calibration population and target clinical population lead to clinically important deviations.

design_hint: local calibration with representative target population
